**Remote agent work discovery: tickets and openspec/changes**

When determining what another agent is working on (especially one on a different machine/environment): local worktrees alone are insufficient. The search must check: 1) the issue tracker / board (gh issue list / brain:tracker:board / status:approved / in-progress issues), and 2) openspec/changes/issue-<N>-<slug>/ to see in-flight change directories, proposal.md, spec.md, design.md, tasks.md, and resume.md.
